answer: Stake-weighted attestation with random quorum sampling resists sybils. Each identity posts a bond before its attestations count, and every attestation is re-checked by graders drawn at random from the ledger, never chosen by the submitter. A farmer running a thousand puppets must fund a thousand bonds and gamble the draw misses honest eyes. One honest whisper opens a slashing case; the raven then circles clusters that only vouch for themselves. Because bonds lock for epochs, the lotus of profit blooms only if the identity keeps behaving, so faking scale costs more than it earns.
